verdict.rationale: SumUp documents Reader SDKs as one of three ways to integrate in-person payments. The docs say they "embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app," with the app driving a card reader over Bluetooth or using Tap to Pay. The SDK docs also cover Tap to Pay and offline store-and-forward transactions. Missing for 10: SDK-level detail (installation, API surface, platform version support) and independent or hands-on corroboration of the iOS/Android SDKs.
